description: This file defines classes and macros for warning reporting and warning categories, including control and configuration mechanisms, serialization, and exclusion handling within a warning reporting system.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing bounds and analysis for warning categories, including serialization, deserialization, and warning level determination.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category with control, analysis, and serialization capabilities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class acting as a proxy for warning reporting units, managing categories, exclusions, and event reporting.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Class managing lists of excluded callsigns and modules for warning reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Static method to configure warning category bounds and settings.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Static method returning the category name.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Method to analyze actual values against bounds and determine if reporting is needed.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes category data and actual value into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into category object.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts category data to string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current actual value qualifies as a warning.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning reporting is enabled.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and revokes control of the warning category.
